requirements.title:
Feature: F1793489: Reach | Expand Manual User Member Alerts (Add 3 New Alerts)
Impacted Applications & Markets: QOM / Reach Portal | National CEQ & WellMed
Objective: Enable Reach/QOM outreach managers to manually create, display, edit, and retire member alerts directly within the member profile left panel to streamline outreach management
requirements.reasoning: Candidate tests cover core operations for this requirement but miss specific boundary/negative paths.

primary_citation.scenario_name: Add new manual member alert and verify orange badge on Left Panel
primary_citation.feature_name: [QOM0031] - Create and Display Manual Member Alerts in Left Panel

citations.scenario_name: Add new manual member alert and verify orange badge on Left Panel
citations.feature_title: [QOM0031] - Create and Display Manual Member Alerts in Left Panel
citations.verifies: This scenario directly addresses the creation and display of new manual member alerts for all three specified alert types ('Out of Country', 'Member request - Hold Outreach', 'Hospitalized'). It verifies key UI/UX specifications for the Left Panel (orange background, info icon, tooltip with start date and notes) and Right Panel ('Manage Member Alerts' drawer, mandatory start date, notes field, save action). However, it does not explicitly verify the 'optional end date' during creation, the 'cancel' action, or the 'toggle between User and System alerts' within the Right Panel drawer. It also does not cover editing, retiring, or the history drawer.
citations.evidence_steps:
When User clicks on "Edit Alerts" icon in member left panel
    Then Verify "Manage Member Alerts" right panel drawer is displayed
    When User selects alert category "<AlertName>"
    And User enters start date "Today" and notes "<NoteText>"
    And User clicks on "Save" button in right panel
    Then User verifies alert "<AlertName>" is visible on the Left Panel with "orange" background
    And User hovers over alert info icon and verifies tooltip contains start date and notes "<NoteText>"
    Examples:
      | AlertName                       | NoteText                              |
      | Out of Country                  | Traveling outside US until next month |
      | Member request - Hold Outreach  | Member requested pause on phone calls |
      | Hospitalized                    | Admitted for inpatient observation    |

citations.scenario_name: Modify active alert end date from Right Panel
citations.feature_title: [QOM0032] - Edit and Retire Manual Member Alerts
citations.verifies: This scenario covers the 'edit' and 'retire' aspects of the requirement. It verifies updating an optional end date and notes, and the subsequent removal of the alert from the Left Panel's active view, signifying retirement. It also explicitly validates the 'toggle between User and System alerts' in the 'Manage Member Alerts' panel. It uses one of the new alert types ('Hospitalized'). However, it doesn't cover alert creation, the full display specifications (info icon, tooltip), the other two new alert types, or the history drawer.
citations.evidence_steps:
When User clicks on "Edit Alerts" icon in member left panel
    And User toggles to "User" alerts tab in "Manage Member Alerts" panel
    And User updates end date to "Today" and notes "Discharged from care" for alert "Hospitalized"
    And User clicks on "Save" button
    Then User verifies alert "Hospitalized" is removed from Left Panel active view

citations.scenario_name: Validate persistent alert indicators while editing member demographic details
citations.feature_title: [QOM0026] - Member Demographics Right Panel and Alert State Consistency
citations.verifies: This scenario indirectly verifies a portion of the 'display' requirement. It confirms that an active manual alert (specifically 'Member request - Hold Outreach', one of the new types) remains visible on the Left Panel with an orange background even when a different right panel (Demographics) is open and being interacted with. It does not cover creating, editing, retiring, full display specifications (tooltip, info icon), or the history drawer. Its primary focus is on UI consistency rather than alert functionality itself.
citations.evidence_steps:
Given Member "Donald Draper" has active manual alert "Member request - Hold Outreach"
    And Verify member left panel still displays alert "Member request - Hold Outreach" in "orange" background
    And Verify member summary details and active alerts remain synchronized on Left Panel

citations.scenario_name: Inactivate alert and verify audit trail in History Drawer
citations.feature_title: [QOM0032] - Edit and Retire Manual Member Alerts
citations.verifies: This scenario directly addresses the 'History Drawer' UI/UX specification. It verifies that the 'History Drawer' opens, shows inactive alerts (specifically 'Hospitalized', one of the new types), and displays audit history (user and updated timestamp). This strongly supports the 'retire' and history aspects. It does not cover creation, active alert display, or editing, and only verifies the 'top row' rather than explicit ordering by inactivation timestamp.
citations.evidence_steps:
When User clicks on "History" icon in "Manage Member Alerts" panel
    Then Verify "History Drawer" opens showing inactive alerts
    And User verifies the top row contains alert "Hospitalized"
    And Verify inactive alert displays last updated by "priority_roster_tester" with current timestamp

covered_criteria: Enable Reach/QOM outreach managers to manually create member alerts.
Manually add three alert types: Out of Country, Member request - Hold Outreach, Hospitalized.
Active alerts display with an orange background on the Left Panel.
Active alerts display with an info icon showing a tooltip with start date and notes.
"Manage Member Alerts" drawer opens via edit icon.
"Manage Member Alerts" drawer contains mandatory start date, optional end date, and notes field.
"Manage Member Alerts" drawer contains save actions.
"Manage Member Alerts" drawer contains a toggle between User and System alerts.
Enable Reach/QOM outreach managers to manually edit member alerts (by updating end date and notes).
Enable Reach/QOM outreach managers to manually retire member alerts (by setting end date, removing from active view).
Inactive/retired alerts display in a History Drawer.
History Drawer displays full audit history (user/system and updated date).
missing_gaps: "Manage Member Alerts" drawer: 'cancel' action functionality is not explicitly tested.
Left Panel tooltip: Verification that the tooltip includes the 'end date' when present, as specified in UI/UX.
History Drawer: Verification that inactive/retired alerts are explicitly 'ordered by most recent inactivation timestamp'.
Negative path testing for alert creation/editing (e.g., missing mandatory fields, invalid dates, exceeding character limits for notes).
Verification that only active alerts are shown on the left panel (e.g., an expired alert is no longer visible).
suggested_tests:
Scenario: Verify 'Cancel' button functionality in 'Manage Member Alerts' drawer
    Given User is on the member profile 'Donald Draper'
    When User clicks on 'Edit Alerts' icon in member left panel
    And User selects alert category 'Out of Country' and enters start date 'Today'
    And User clicks on 'Cancel' button in right panel
    Then User verifies no new alert is visible on the Left Panel
    And User verifies 'Manage Member Alerts' right panel drawer is closed

Scenario: Validate tooltip displays start date, end date, and notes for active alerts
    Given User is on the member profile 'Donald Draper'
    And Member 'Donald Draper' has an active alert 'Out of Country' with start date '2023-01-01', end date '2023-12-31' and notes 'Away for the year'
    When User hovers over alert info icon for 'Out of Country' on Left Panel
    Then User verifies tooltip contains start date '2023-01-01', end date '2023-12-31' and notes 'Away for the year'

Scenario: Verify inactive alerts in History Drawer are ordered by most recent inactivation timestamp
    Given User is on the member profile 'Donald Draper'
    And Member 'Donald Draper' has multiple inactive alerts with different inactivation dates
    When User clicks on 'Edit Alerts' icon in member left panel
    And User clicks on 'History' icon in 'Manage Member Alerts' panel
    Then Verify 'History Drawer' opens showing inactive alerts
    And User verifies inactive alerts are displayed in descending order of inactivation timestamp

Scenario: Attempt to create manual alert with missing mandatory start date
    Given User is on the member profile 'Donald Draper'
    When User clicks on 'Edit Alerts' icon in member left panel
    And User selects alert category 'Hospitalized'
    And User leaves start date empty and enters notes 'Patient admitted'
    And User clicks on 'Save' button in right panel
    Then an error message 'Start Date is mandatory' should be displayed
